name: attendance-streaks
title: Longest attendance streak (gaps and islands)
prompt:
Write `query.sql`: one SQLite `SELECT` over `attendance(student_id, day, present)` (schema in
`school.sql`; `day` is `YYYY-MM-DD`, `present` is 1 or 0, at most one row per student and day) that
returns, for every student with at least one present day, their longest streak of CONSECUTIVE
CALENDAR DAYS present.
- a streak breaks on an absent day AND on a missing calendar day (e.g. a weekend with no row)
- columns: `student_id`, `longest_streak`, `streak_start` (first day of that streak; on ties, the earliest)
- order by `longest_streak` descending, then `student_id`
